data.title: Award of the Global Talent Scholarship 2026/27
data.summary: The Global Talent Scholarship Foundation has awarded Sam Rivera a scholarship for the 2026/27 academic year, paying a monthly stipend of €450.00 from October 2026 to September 2027, with a first progress report due on 15 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is your official award letter confirming a scholarship for 2026/27. You will receive €450 per month from October 2026 to September 2027 by bank transfer around the first working day of each month. To keep the funding, stay enrolled full-time at Hochschule Musterstadt, upload your enrolment certificate each semester to the portal, and submit your first progress report (countersigned by your supervisor) by 15 December 2026. Tell the foundation within two weeks of any change to your address, bank details or study status, and report any other scholarship or grant before accepting it. You're invited to the Autumn Meeting in Berlin on 7 November 2026; a separate invitation with the programme will follow. Keep this letter for your tax records.

key_facts.quote:

bank transfer on or around the first working day of each month.

key_facts.label: First progress report due
key_facts.quote: Your first progress report is due on 15 December 2026.

key_facts.label: Notification period for changes
key_facts.quote:
Please notify us of any change of address, bank details or study status within two weeks of
the change.

items.title: Receive monthly scholarship stipend
items.action: No action needed; the stipend arrives automatically each month.
items.quote:
The monthly stipend of EUR 450.00 will be paid from October 2026 to September 2027 by
bank transfer on or around the first working day of each month.

date.text: on or around the first working day of each month

items.title: Upload certificate of enrolment each semester
items.action: Upload your certificate of enrolment for each semester to the scholarship portal.
items.quote:
You remain enrolled as a full-time student at Hochschule Musterstadt throughout the funding
period and upload your certificate of enrolment for each semester to the scholarship portal.

date.text: throughout the funding period, each semester

items.title: Submit first progress report
items.action: Submit your first progress report (max. two pages, countersigned by your academic supervisor) via the scholarship portal using the provided template.
items.quote: Your first progress report is due on 15 December 2026.

items.title: Notify foundation of any change of address, bank details or study status
items.action: Inform the foundation of any change to your address, bank details or study status within two weeks of the change occurring.
items.quote:
Please notify us of any change of address, bank details or study status within two weeks of
the change.

date.text: within two weeks of the change

items.title: Report other scholarships or grants before accepting
items.action: Report any other scholarship or grant to the foundation before accepting it.
items.quote: Other scholarships or grants must be reported to us before you accept them.

items.title: Attend Autumn Meeting in Berlin
items.action: Attend the Autumn Meeting for scholars in Berlin; wait for the separate invitation with the programme.
items.quote:
We look forward to welcoming you to our scholar community at the Autumn Meeting in Berlin on 7
November 2026.

date.text: Autumn Meeting in Berlin on 7 November 2026

data.tax_note: The letter states the scholarship stipend is generally tax-free under §3 No. 44 of the German Income Tax Act (EStG); keep this letter as documentation for your tax records even though no tax is likely due.
